links.outcome: External validation performance of OCT segmentation AI on consecutive real-world patients versus expert reference
links.effect: Calcified plaque agreement excellent (κ=0.88); lipid plaque reasonable (κ=0.68); low-prevalence features such as plaque rupture had limited performance.
links.quote: The algorithm performance for low-prevalence features (e.g., plaque rupture) was limited.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of a previously developed AI algorithm (OCT-AID) for intracoronary OCT full-vessel segmentation using real-world consecutive patient data. It evaluates model accuracy/generalizability without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
